transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I guess I'm here because I've been having a little trouble staying on task lately? It's probably nothing major, I mean, I know everyone gets distracted sometimes. But... well, I just seem to get pulled off track by every little sound or, like, every little thought. 

I'll be trying to work on a job application, and then a car will go by outside, or my phone lights up, or I just get some random idea in my head. And before I even realize it, I'm doing something completely different. I really am trying hard to focus and get things done,
Did you have this same kind of trouble focusing when you were a child?

Um, yeah, I guess so. I mean, I wasn't a bad kid or anything, I promise! But... yeah, even back in elementary school, I think my teachers got a little frustrated with me sometimes? Is it okay that I'm saying that? 

They were always moving my seat around because I guess I talked out of turn a bit. And, um, I would sometimes forget my homework, or I'd rush through my worksheets and make silly, careless mistakes. I always felt really bad about it, and I tried to do better, but it was just hard to keep everything straight. I hope that makes sense?
Are these focus problems causing significant trouble in your day-to-day life right now?

Um, well... I wouldn't say it's *ruining* my life or anything. I'm doing my best, really. But... I guess it is causing some hiccups? Is it alright to call them hiccups? 

It's just that I really want to be an automotive technician. I know I'm good at the hands-on stuff, I really am. But... well, I've kind of missed a few training deadlines. And I've had to redo my applications a couple of times because I messed up the paperwork. It's a little embarrassing to admit, honestly. I'm trying so hard, but I just feel like I'm stuck and not moving forward like I should be. I hope you don't think I'm just being lazy... I really do want to get this sorted out. Does that sound like what you were asking about?
When you try to focus, do you often feel anxious?

Um, anxious? I don't... I don't think so? I mean, I hope it's okay to say no to that. I definitely get a little stressed out sometimes, just because I really want to do a good job and I know I'm messing up. But I don't feel, like, panicky or scared or anything like that. 

It's more just... frustrating, I guess? Like I know I should be able to just sit down and do it, and I feel bad that I can't. But it's not really an anxious feeling. Does that make sense? I really hope I'm answering your questions right... I just want to give you the best information I can.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um, depressed? No, I don't think so. I mean, I have days where I feel a little bummed out, mostly just because I'm frustrated with myself about the training stuff, you know? But I'm definitely not depressed. I try to stay really positive about things, I promise. I hope that's the right answer? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm sitting around feeling sorry for myself or anything like that. I'm actually a pretty upbeat guy most of the time! Is that helpful?
